items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: In our new band now we have Ricky Woodard

ctx.x: He could have gone broke if he had to pay royalties to all the fellows that he took licks from.
Snooky had certain things, Curtis Peagler had his certain thing, and naturally Cat Daddy and Ricky Woodard, he had his certain thing. You’d always know it’s Ricky because you hear this thing.
Yeah. Once you hear it, oh, that’s Ricky.
